title: Gemfile loads a gemspec from a build-machine path
description: Gemfile declares a `gemspec` directive that points at a path rather than a gemspec name. The dependency set of the build is decided by a file outside the repository's review, so the resolved gems are unknown.
remediation: Keep the gemspec inside the repository and reference it by name.
limitation: It matches a `gemspec` directive that points at a path rather than a gemspec name in the parsed Gemfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
